mentions.name: 3D Snake Game for Steam Deck
mentions.description: A 3D take on the classic snake game built for the Steam Deck, inspired by a recent spherical snake post. It also serves as a first-time exercise in publishing a game to Steam.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Hacking together a little 3d snake game for my steamdeck, heavily “inspired” by that spherical snake post last week.

Never published to Steam before, it’s been a fun learning process.
